description: Applies one edit to up to 5000 contacts, as the Contacts page's selection bar does: op add_to_list / remove_from_list (listId), add_tags / remove_tags (tagIds), set_service_category (value residential, commercial, both or null), set_lead_source (value thumbtack, google_lsa, yelp, bark, website_form, google_business_profile, referral, booking_software, direct, web_chat, other or null), set_type (type client, lead, applicant, other), archive, mark_spam (at most 500 for the last three; a type change or spam tags or untags the Quo card when the business's write setting allows). Each contact answers succeeded, skipped (already so) or failed. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; every op is safe to repeat.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: edit_contacts
title: Edit contacts in bulk
